source_tuple: For every lifecycle operation outer SourceRootID=target_root_id and SourceSpaceID=target Space. Hash outer SourceArchiveSha256 over exact request JSON; source_archive_sha256 inside lifecycle response is empty.
archive_witness: Actual Archive tree identity, nonempty sorted heads and membership are captured with Archive-before-root locks; archive/restore require all three exact witnesses in addition to root token. Any Archive tree change causes no-effects conflict.
promotion_witness: Actual one complete native Torah manifest JSON+SHA+heads and native destination type ID+unique key+heads; no arbitrary caller destination type. Normal SetObjectTypesInState(false) and Apply.
classification: Receipt annotation or promoted_document. Root native metadata remains annotation/legacy original value until explicit promotion, then exact role chiddush/article/research.
bounds: JSON request max2MiB; original exported ZIP max1MiB; original response max2MiB without truncation.
accepted_receipt_requires: Actual registered one-use Import request, copied complete typed response, original Account/Space owner, actual operation Done/Cancel/drain; no caller-completion flags.
Accepted status only for requested operation; no success receipt for conflict/refused/applied_unconfirmed or pending disposal.
Genuine original ZIP, exact native_archive_sha256, positive original ExportReport and complete identity mapping of every exported snapshot. Outer NativeArchiveSha256 hashes the response JSON.

Root heads/root_snapshot_sha256 remain independent from Archive or promoted-root mutation_object_id/before_mutation_heads/mutation_heads. NativeApplyAttempted and NativeWriteObserved are actual effects, never remote ACK.
Archive state and native index projection are read back; original root body preserved. Promotion compares full rich payload, links, anchors, identities and exact manifest-bound destination type.

Separate current-lifetime lifecycle token is nonconstructible and binds exact Host source UUID/revision/witness. Durable Host intent/request witness precedes one-use dispatch. Historical serialized result is not live authority.
post_promotion: The ordinary Annotation-only read/replace validator stays unchanged. read_promoted requires document_role and a separate native manifest/type/marker verifier; archive/restore of a promoted object declare the same document_role.
